cores.scope: Metadata preselected core, fixed physical member hashes and saved weights. Survey+reference full2D terms close saved covariance. Bright Gaia conditional apparent positions include annual parallax; exposure/CCD/field blocks first aggregate per star, require>=5 stars for residual statistics. Shared-group/stellar colour effects are diagnostics, not new calibration or independent spatial certification.
